summary_en: Annual dividend raised to 52 yen/share (interim 26 yen + year-end 26 yen, +1 yen each) for FY3/27, vs. prior guidance of 50 yen/share. Dividend on equity target of 3.0% expected to be achieved. Prior year (FY3/26) was 43 yen/share.
translation_en_brief:
On 13 August 2026, Starzen announced a revision to its dividend forecast for the second half of FY3/27 (year ending 31 March 2027). The interim dividend (second quarter) and year-end dividend were each increased by 1 yen, from 25 yen to 26 yen per share, raising the annual total from 50 yen to 52 yen per share.

The increase is driven by the company's medium-term management plan (announced November 2025), which targets early achievement and further expansion of a 3.0% dividend on equity (DOE) ratio. Based on recent performance trends, management determined that a higher payout to shareholders was warranted. The revision is expected to deliver the 3.0% DOE target. Prior-year (FY3/26) annual dividend was 43 yen per share; a 3-for-1 stock split was executed on 1 April 2025, and historical figures have been adjusted accordingly.
